mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the permission matrix definition removes the structural encoding of role-operation grants. Assertions checking that members can create tasks and admins can edit/delete will fail when the matrix is undefined.

Removing the append-only constraint allows audit entries for the same task to duplicate or mutate. Assertions checking append-only will find counterexamples where ae1 and ae2 with the same task are identical (violating the distinctness check).
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_DuplicateAuditEntry { some disj ae1, ae2: AuditEntry | ae1.task = ae2.task and ae1 = ae2 }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing cross-team isolation allows audit entries to leak across team boundaries. Assertions checking cross-team isolation will fail when a user not in a team can see that team's audit entries.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CrossTeamLeak { some t: Task, u: User, ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t and ae.actor = u and (no tm: TeamMembership | tm.user = u and tm.team = t.team) }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the restriction allows non-owner members to edit and delete any task. Assertions checking that members cannot edit others' tasks will fail.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_MemberEditOthers { (Member -> PatchTask) in PermMatrix.Allowed or (Member -> DeleteTask) in PermMatrix.Allowed }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the requirement that every task has an audit entry allows tasks without any audit history. Assertions checking audit completeness will fail when a task has no corresponding audit entries.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NoAudit { some t: Task | no ae: AuditEntry | ae.task = t }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the requirement that a task's owner is a member of the task's team breaks the structural link between ownership and team membership. Access control based on ownership will become meaningless.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_OwnerNotMember { some t: Task | no tm: TeamMembership | tm.user = t.owner and tm.team = t.team }
